value.summary: This change adds price entries for four models (including two deepseek variants), updates the date comment, and adds three new unit tests that lock in cost behaviour for the new GLM model.  The prices are hard-coded constants derived from external vendor measurements; they do not reach a dangerous sink, introduce new network or subprocess calls, deserialize untrusted data, or touch authentication or permissions.  No secrets are present, no CI configuration is altered, and the only dependency change is to the date documentation.  The change looks sound.
